title: ADHD Has Only 2 Times: NOW and NOT NOW 😂 ADHD Time Blindness #shorts
description:
Dentist at 3. It's 11. That's basically next week... 😂

Psychologist Dr. Russell Barkley describes ADHD as time blindness: the brain sorts time into "now" and "not now." It's not lazy. It's how the clock feels.

Tip: set TWO alarms. One to START getting ready, not one to leave.

"So teach us to number our days" (Psalm 90:12).

What's YOUR "not now" record? 👇
